remarks: A wonderful lifestyle awaits at Birchwood Condominiums, where low-maintenance living meets exceptional convenience. Ideally located on the Westport-Norwalk border, this sun-filled 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence offers a rare combination of privacy, natural beauty, and walkable access to everyday essentials, including Whole Foods just across the street.  Set at the top of Hills Lane in a peaceful, secluded setting, the home enjoys tranquil treetop views. The spacious living and dining areas feature a wood-burning fireplace and open to a private deck, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The eat-in kitchen includes a generous pantry and has been updated with a Samsung appliance package (2020), Moen fixtures, and a new garbage disposal.  Recent improvements enhance comfort and style throughout, including new windows and sliding door (2020), new HVAC (2020), and 2025 updates featuring new ceiling fans, light fixtures, hall bath vanity, fixtures, mirror, and Kohler toilets. The primary suite includes a dressing area, while two additional bedrooms offer flexibility for guests or home office.  Additional highlights include a reserved covered parking space, private storage unit, and convenient access to the pool and clubhouse. Enjoy a Westport mailing address with Norwalk taxes, schools, and amenities, all just minutes to downtown Westport, beaches, train, and dining.
